values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Thompson lists 'Primitive Camping' among its recreational opportunities and 'Parking is provided in 11 designated parking areas'; its ridge-top tract is reached from Linden on Route 638 (Freezeland Road), continuing 'on the unimproved Fire Trail'.
